name: Haus Mitterhorn
beschreibung: The Haus Mitterhorn is situated in a tranquil, sunny spot in St. Ulrich am Pillersee within the scenic Pillerseetal in the Kitzbühel Alps. The spacious holiday apartment is comfortably furnished, offering a fully equipped kitchen for relaxed self-catering, inviting bedrooms, and a sunny balcony with breathtaking views of Mount Mitterhorn and the rugged Loferer Steinberge. A short walk brings visitors to the emerald-green Lake Pillersee, perfect for summer strolls, rowing, and cooling off. In winter, the snow-reliable slopes of the Buchensteinwand ski area crowned by the famous Jakobskreuz cross, along with the valley's premier cross-country skiing trail network, provide superb snow sports.
kurzbeschreibung: Quiet holiday apartment in St. Ulrich am Pillersee featuring a fully equipped kitchen and views of the Loferer Steinberge.
